defmodule ChatWeb.Plugs.RateLimit do
  import Plug.Conn

  def init(opts), do: Keyword.merge([limit: 20, scale_ms: 60_000], opts)

  def call(conn, opts) do
    key = "messages:#{conn.assigns.current_user.id}"

    case Hammer.check_rate(key, opts[:scale_ms], opts[:limit]) do
      {:allow, _count} -> conn
      {:deny, _limit} -> conn |> send_resp(429, "rate limited") |> halt()
    end
  end
end
